intro.t: A boutique brokerage *that knows Three Village.*
intro.text: Gina Lollo owns Northshore Properties Realty, a locally owned boutique brokerage on Main Street in Setauket. Licensed in New York and Florida, she's a Certified Buyer Representative and a 55 and Better specialist who helps families buy, sell and relocate across Setauket, Stony Brook, Port Jefferson, Smithtown and beyond, with a team that lives here too.
